roadmap.title: Play the main story
roadmap.description: Clear all 15 chapters on the default difficulty. Every story achievement is automatic and nothing is missable. Stop in Chapter 12 to run the Sotenbori Battle Arena for levels, money, and gear before the late-game difficulty spike.

roadmap.title: Substories and bonds
roadmap.description: Finish 40 of the 52 substories for the three substory achievements, and raise each party member's bond to level 5. Bonds rise from restaurant visits, Party Chats, battles, movies, and hostess clubs; bond events happen at Survive bar.

roadmap.title: Business management
roadmap.description: Push Ichiban Confections from rank 150 to rank 1. Reach rank 50 for the office move, buy 10 companies, max Eri's bond automatically, then keep running the minigame to bank 10 billion Yen.

roadmap.title: Part-time Hero, school, and Personality
roadmap.description: Complete Part-time Hero quests to reach 300 Member Points, pass 10 Ounabara Vocational School exams, and finish the activities that feed Personality stats. Raise Kasuga's six stats to level 10, using Rise Up! from Dragon Kart as a top-up.

roadmap.title: Minigames and collection
roadmap.description: Win all Dragon Kart cups and rival races, clear the three Can Quest courses, watch all 10 Seagull Cinema movies, find all 5 Honk-Honk NPCs, play 10 minigames, and work through the gear and Sujimon collection counters along the way.

roadmap.title: Jobs and job ranks
roadmap.description: Change Kasuga through all 8 non-default jobs, then raise any 7 jobs across the party to rank 30. Job XP comes naturally from story and dungeon fights and faster from the sewers grind.

roadmap.title: Sotenbori Battle Arena
roadmap.description: Beat all 30 floors of the Sotenbori Battle Arena, using the checkpoint every fifth floor to leave and heal. Optional floor bonuses are not required.

roadmap.title: Endgame grind and dungeons
roadmap.description: Grind the Kamurocho sewers to player level 99 and several maxed jobs per character, then clear the Final Millennium Tower and the True Final Millennium Tower. Fund Romance Workshop to level 4 with the money earned.

achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement in Yakuza: Like a Dragon.

steps.text: Unlock the other 62 achievements to earn The New Dragon.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 1 of the main story.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 1.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 2 of the main story.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 2.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 3 of the main story.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 3.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 4 of the main story.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 4.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 5 of the main story.

guide.context: Chapter 5 introduces Part-Time Hero, weapon crafting, and the Business Management minigame. Near the end the game asks you to confirm your level before leaving Ijincho and recommends at least level 15 for the two waves of level 17 enemies that follow.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 5.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 6 of the main story.

guide.context: Chapter 6 begins with a dungeon escape that starts with Kasuga alone on the Freelancer job, then gives you the full party. Check side paths for silver safes, and use the healing spots to top up before the level 17 to 19 Seiryu fight at the end.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 6, including the opening dungeon escape and the final Seiryu fight.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 7 of the main story.

guide.context: Nanba is absent for the back half of Chapter 7, so wrap up side activities before the point where he leaves. Kasuga is fully healed after the Joon-gi Han fight, but the escape fights against the Geomijul that follow are fought short-handed.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 7, including the Joon-gi Han fight and the escape from the Geomijul hideout.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 8 of the main story.

guide.context: The chapter closes with a level 25 Mabuchi fight. Mabuchi counters attacks while using Resolute Counter, so heal or buff on those turns instead of attacking; Poundmates are safe because he does not counter them.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 8, including the Bleach Japan fights and the Mabuchi fight.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 9 of the main story.

guide.context: After the crane fight you can resupply before continuing. The Geomijul rematch pits you against Ishioda, Nanba, and about level 25 Bleach Japan enemies; Ishioda's gunshot hits one character hard, so keep the party above half health.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 9, including the crane fight and the Geomijul rematch.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 10 of the main story.

guide.context: Joon-gi Han joins early in Chapter 10 with a weak starting weapon, but the restaurant you fight through later holds an upgrade inside one of its safes. The closing Mabuchi fight includes four Liumang, and Mabuchi cannot counter ranged attacks such as Joon-gi Han's gun skills.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 10, including the restaurant fights and the second Mabuchi fight.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 11 of the main story.

guide.context: Chapter 11 sends several Omi groups at you in a row; Nanba's fire group skill clears the lower-level grunts so you can focus the highest-level enemy. The final group includes Matoba, who resists knife and gun but takes extra damage from fire and electric attacks.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 11, including the consecutive Omi fights and the Matoba fight.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 12 of the main story.

guide.context: The chapter opens by requiring 3 million Yen for a political campaign; the Italian Ring and Swiss Watch picked up during Chapter 11 sell for about 1.5 million. This chapter also opens the Sotenbori Battle Arena, and clearing it now eases the late-game level jump. In Omi HQ, stay out of the guards' sightlines; three detections restart the area with guards respawned. The chapter ends against level 50 Majima and Saejima: both resist knife, Majima is weak to fire and his clones to gun, and Saejima is weak to fire.

steps.text: Raise 3 million Yen, selling the Italian Ring and the Swiss Watch if needed.
Cross Omi HQ without being spotted three times.
Beat Majima and Saejima at the end of the chapter.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 13 of the main story.

guide.context: The chapter ends with a level 53 Sawashiro fight that moves through three weapon phases. He is weak to knife, and in the final phase he regenerates 1000 HP each turn, so keep damage on him; a new Poundmate becomes available from Kamulop around this point.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 13, including the Sawashiro fight.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 14 of the main story.

guide.context: Chapter 14 includes a Kiryu fight. Kiryu refuses to attack female party members and takes extra damage only from Ice while resisting Physical, Knife, Gun, and Fire; he switches stances to dodge and counter, so unblockable or ranged attacks are safer than standard ones.

steps.text: Finish the main story missions for Chapter 14, including the Kiryu fight and the fights that follow.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 15, the final chapter.

guide.context: Entering the Millennium Tower at the end of Chapter 15 is a point of no return for the story, and the climb runs from level 57 enemies to a level 60 final boss. You cannot backtrack past each floor's healing boxes, so top up before the elevator. The final one-on-one against Masato forces the Freelancer job, so give it a few levels beforehand.

steps.text: Clear the Millennium Tower fights, including Tendo and then Aoki with his Omi reinforcements.
Beat Masato in the forced solo Freelancer fight to finish the story.

achievements.summary: Complete 10 substories.

guide.context: There are 52 substories, and more appear as you advance the story and raise Kasuga's Personality stats; some need minimum Personality levels to finish. Nothing expires, so uncompleted substories can be wrapped up in Premium Adventure.

steps.text: Approach the marked people who offer substories around Ijincho and finish 10 of them.

achievements.summary: Complete 20 substories.

guide.context: There are 52 substories total and nothing expires. New ones unlock with story progress and with higher Personality stats, and any you skip remain available in Premium Adventure.

steps.text: Finish 20 substories by talking to the marked characters around Ijincho as they appear.

achievements.summary: Complete 40 substories.

guide.context: There are 52 substories total, so 40 finishes the achievement with room to skip the harder stat-gated ones. Nothing expires, and leftover substories stay available in Premium Adventure.

steps.text: Finish 40 substories across Ijincho, Sotenbori, and Kamurocho as they unlock.

achievements.summary: Raise Nanba's bond to level 5.

guide.context: Nanba joins in Chapter 3, and his bond cannot advance past level 2 until Chapter 10, so this finishes late. Bond progress builds from eating at restaurants together, Party Chats, battles, movies, and hostess clubs; when the gauge for the next level fills, return to Survive bar to trigger the bond event.

steps.text: Fill Nanba's bond gauge to the level 5 event at Survive bar, then win the solo fight there against one level 20 and two level 18 enemies.

achievements.summary: Raise Adachi's bond to level 5.

guide.context: Adachi joins in Chapter 2 and his bond advances steadily throughout the game. Bond progress comes from shared restaurant meals, Party Chats, battles, movies, and hostess clubs; once the gauge for the next level fills, go to Survive bar for the bond event.

steps.text: Fill Adachi's bond gauge to the level 5 event at Survive bar, then win the solo fight there against one level 19 enemy.

achievements.summary: Raise Saeko's bond to level 5.

guide.context: Saeko joins in Chapter 5 and her bond advances steadily throughout the game. Bond progress comes from shared restaurant meals, Party Chats, battles, movies, and hostess clubs; when the next level's gauge fills, go to Survive bar for the bond event.

steps.text: Fill Saeko's bond gauge to the level 5 event at Survive bar, then win the solo fight there against four level 19 and one level 21 enemy.

achievements.summary: Raise Joon-gi Han's bond to level 5.

guide.context: Joon-gi Han joins in Chapter 10 and his bond advances steadily after that. Bond progress comes from shared restaurant meals, Party Chats, battles, movies, and hostess clubs; when the next level's gauge fills, go to Survive bar for the bond event.

steps.text: Fill Joon-gi Han's bond gauge to the level 5 event at Survive bar, then win the solo fight there against one level 39 Jingweon mafia member and four level 36 enemies.

achievements.summary: Raise Zhao's bond to level 5.

guide.context: Zhao joins in Chapter 11, so his bond is finished in the late game or in Premium Adventure. Bond progress comes from shared restaurant meals, Party Chats, battles, movies, and hostess clubs; when the next level's gauge fills, go to Survive bar for the bond event.

steps.text: Fill Zhao's bond gauge to the level 5 event at Survive bar, then win the solo fight there against level 32 Mabuchi, level 30 Zheng, and four level 28 enemies; avoid attacking Mabuchi while he uses Resolute Counter.

achievements.summary: Raise Eri's bond to level 5.

guide.context: Eri is added to the party after Ichiban Confections reaches the top 100 in Business Management and you talk to her at Survive bar. Her bond does not rise from normal activities; it only advances at Business Management rank milestones, so it reaches level 5 automatically at rank 1 alongside Presidential Power.

steps.text: Play Business Management through to rank 1; Eri's bond maxes during the same reward sequence.

achievements.description: Viewed more than 20 Table Talk scenes.
achievements.summary: View more than 20 Table Talk scenes at Ijincho restaurants.

guide.context: Table Talks only appear at restaurants in Ijincho, not in Kamurocho or Sotenbori, and only when you order specific menu items with the matching party members present. Waiting until Chapter 11, when Zhao joins, gives you every character at once.

steps.text: Take the full party to Ijincho restaurants and order a broad spread of menu items, eating until the Table Talk total passes 20.
steps.note: Track the count in Part-Time Hero under Challenge, then Adventure, then Table Talker.

achievements.description: Raised Part-time Hero Member Rank to Senior Hero.
achievements.summary: Reach the Senior Hero rank in Part-Time Hero by collecting 70 Member Points.

guide.context: Member Points come from Part-Time Hero Support and Rescue quests and accumulate across ranks rather than resetting. The rank thresholds are Junior Hero at 15 points, Senior Hero at 70, Veteran Hero at 150, and Executive Hero at 300.

steps.text: Complete Support and Rescue quests until your total Member Points reach 70.

achievements.description: Raised Part-time Hero Member Rank to Executive Hero.
achievements.summary: Reach the Executive Hero rank in Part-Time Hero by collecting 300 Member Points.

guide.context: Member Points accumulate across ranks and are earned from Part-Time Hero Support and Rescue quests. Many delivery requests fill themselves as you pick up items in normal play, and SOS Rescue jobs appear on the map; the Special Delivery chain needs 21 Pocket Tissues bought with 4,200 Can Quest points.

steps.text: Keep completing Support and Rescue quests until your total Member Points reach 300.

achievements.summary: Reach level 10 with Kasuga.

steps.text: Win battles and complete early story and side content until Kasuga reaches level 10.

achievements.summary: Reach level 30 with Kasuga.

steps.text: Keep fighting enemies and completing story content until Kasuga reaches level 30.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Kasuga.

guide.context: Normal story progression reaches level 50 by the endgame, since the final dungeon's enemies climb toward level 60. To get there faster, repeat the final five floors of the Sotenbori Battle Arena from Chapter 12.

steps.text: Fight through the late chapters, or grind the Sotenbori Battle Arena, until Kasuga reaches level 50.

achievements.summary: Reach level 70 with Kasuga.

guide.context: Level 70 comes after the story unless you grind heavily. From Chapter 15, the Kamurocho Underground Sewers is the fastest spot: on the second floor, Invested Vagabond enemies award around 450,000 experience each, and multi-hit skills such as Joon-gi Han's Rapid Shot bypass their high defense.

steps.text: Grind Invested Vagabond enemy groups in the Kamurocho Underground Sewers second floor until Kasuga reaches level 70.

achievements.description: Raised one of Kasuga's personality stats to max.
achievements.summary: Raise one of Kasuga's six Personality stats to level 10.

guide.context: Personality stats grow from many activities and are usually a late cleanup task. The Rise Up! item sold at Dragon Kart for 2,500 rings adds 50 points to every Personality stat at once, which is a quick way to finish a stat that is close.

steps.text: Raise any one Personality stat to level 10 through activities, topping it up with Rise Up! from Dragon Kart if needed.

achievements.description: Raised all of Kasuga's personality stats to max.
achievements.summary: Raise all six of Kasuga's Personality stats to level 10.

guide.context: Each Rise Up! purchase at Dragon Kart costs 2,500 rings and adds 50 points to all six stats, so it is the most reliable way to finish the stragglers. Several activities also feed the stats directly, including Ounabara Vocational School exams, Dragon Kart cups and rival races, the Seagull Cinema movies, and the Honk-Honk NPCs.

steps.text: Raise all six Personality stats to level 10, using repeated Rise Up! purchases from Dragon Kart to close the gap.

achievements.description: Changed Kasuga to three different jobs other than his starting job.
achievements.summary: Change Kasuga into three jobs other than Freelancer and Hero.

guide.context: Job changing unlocks at Hello Work during the early chapters. Freelancer and Hero are Kasuga's default jobs, so neither counts toward the total.

steps.text: At Hello Work, rotate Kasuga through three jobs besides Freelancer and Hero.

achievements.description: Changed Kasuga to eight different jobs other than his starting job.
achievements.summary: Change Kasuga into eight jobs other than Freelancer and Hero.

guide.context: Every job must be unlocked before it can be selected. Kasuga needs player level 20 and Personality levels Style 3, Charisma 3, Kindness 5, Passion 5, Confidence 7, and Intellect 7. The eight jobs that count are Breaker, Bodyguard, Chef, Enforcer, Foreman, Fortuneteller, Host, and Musician. Kasuga's Freelancer and Hero jobs are excluded from the total.

steps.text: At Hello Work, change Kasuga through all eight non-default jobs, one after another.

achievements.description: Changed all four party members to jobs different from their default jobs and won a battle.
achievements.summary: Change all four active party members to non-default jobs and win one battle.

guide.context: This is easiest right after job changing unlocks, while Ijincho enemies are still low level. Each member has an alternate job available immediately, and you can switch everyone back once the battle is won.

steps.text: Set each of the four active party members to a job other than their default at Hello Work.
Win one battle with that party to unlock the achievement.

achievements.summary: Raise any one job on any character to rank 30.

guide.context: Job rank is separate from character level, and the 'max' shown by these achievements is rank 30 even though jobs can reach 99.

steps.text: Keep a job equipped on any character until its rank reaches 30.

achievements.summary: Raise any three jobs across the party to rank 30.

guide.context: The three ranks can come from any combination of jobs and characters; you do not need three maxed jobs on one character.

steps.text: Raise three different jobs on any characters to rank 30.

achievements.summary: Raise any seven jobs across the party to rank 30.

guide.context: Ranks count across all characters, so keeping a fixed job on each member through the story usually reaches rank 30 around character level 60. Job experience accessories and the sewer grind speed this up.

steps.text: Raise seven different jobs on any characters to rank 30.

achievements.description: Made 10 pieces of gear at Romance Workshop.
achievements.summary: Craft or upgrade ten pieces of equipment at Romance Workshop.

guide.context: Romance Workshop handles both crafting new gear and upgrading existing gear, and an upgrade counts toward the total.

steps.text: Craft or enhance items at Romance Workshop until you have made or upgraded ten pieces.

achievements.summary: Fund all four upgrade levels of Romance Workshop.

guide.context: The workshop starts at level 1, and levels 2 through 4 cost 200,000, 2,000,000, and 20,000,000 Yen, about 22 million total. After the story, each successful Business Management shareholder meeting pays about 3 million Yen, making it the quickest source of the money.

steps.text: Open Romance Workshop, choose the funding option, and pay through all four upgrade levels.

achievements.summary: Collect more than 100 pieces of gear.

guide.context: The total is cumulative and duplicates count, so gear does not need to be held and spare pieces can be sold safely.

steps.text: Pick up, buy, craft, and earn gear from quests until more than 100 pieces have been collected.

achievements.summary: Collect more than 200 pieces of gear.

guide.context: Head, body, foot, and accessory gear all count, and the total is cumulative with duplicates included, so selling unwanted gear does not set you back. Normal dungeon looting plus a few shop and crafting purchases is usually enough.

steps.text: Keep collecting gear from dungeons, shops, Romance Workshop, and quests until more than 200 pieces have been obtained.

achievements.displayName: I Wanna Be the Very Best
achievements.description: Registered over 100 Sujimon to the Sujidex.
achievements.summary: Register more than 100 Sujimon in the Sujidex.

guide.context: Defeating an enemy registers it in the Sujidex, bosses included, and there are 252 entries in total.

steps.text: Fight enemies throughout the story and dungeons until more than 100 Sujimon are registered.

achievements.description: Registered over 200 Sujimon to the Sujidex.
achievements.summary: Register more than 200 Sujimon in the Sujidex.

guide.context: There are 252 Sujimon total, so normal play through the story and the Sotenbori Battle Arena usually crosses 200 without a dedicated hunt.

steps.text: Keep defeating enemy types across the story, dungeons, and Battle Arena until more than 200 Sujimon are registered.
steps.note: Use the count at the top of the Sujidex, which tracks the achievement; the Part-Time Hero challenge counter differs.

achievements.summary: Call for Poundmates 30 times in battle.

guide.context: Poundmates is a paid battle-summon app obtained in Chapter 4, and the first call for each newly unlocked character is free. Progress is tracked in Part-Time Hero under Challenge, then Battle, then the Pound Town objectives.

steps.text: Use any Poundmate summon during battle until the total reaches 30 calls.

achievements.summary: Beat all 30 floors of the Sotenbori Battle Arena.

guide.context: The arena opens in Chapter 12 and offers a checkpoint every fifth floor, so you can leave to heal and resupply and restart from the last checkpoint. Losing does not cause a game over; you are returned to the entrance.

steps.text: Clear floors 1 through 30 of the Sotenbori Battle Arena, leaving to heal at checkpoints when needed.
steps.note: The optional per-floor bonus objectives are not required for the achievement.

achievements.description: Completed the last dungeon in Premium Adventure.
achievements.summary: Clear the Final Millennium Tower in Premium Adventure.

guide.context: This is the first of the two post-story dungeons, not the last. Enemies climb from about level 61 to level 80, ending with Amon on the top floor. Grind one job to max before entering, and deposit money at a Poppo ATM first because only the final boss allows a retry.

steps.text: Clear every floor of the Final Millennium Tower, then beat Amon on the top floor.

achievements.description: Exceed 10 billion yen in capital for Kasuga's company.
achievements.summary: Hold more than 10 billion Yen of capital in Ichiban Holdings.

guide.context: Capital is spent to raise your share level, so chase this after reaching rank 1. Each successful shareholder meeting pays about 3 million Yen, making repeated Business Management periods the fastest route.

steps.text: Keep running Business Management periods and shareholder meetings until capital exceeds 10 billion Yen.

achievements.description: Moved Kasuga's company into a new office.
achievements.summary: Reach Business Shares rank 50, which moves Ichiban Holdings to a new office.

guide.context: The headquarters move happens automatically in a story scene once the rank is reached, and the minigame then relocates to a building in Chinatown.

steps.text: Raise Ichiban Confections until it sits at Business Shares rank 50.

achievements.description: Raised Kasuga's company into the top company in Yokohama.
achievements.summary: Raise Ichiban Holdings to the top company in Yokohama.

guide.context: Business Management starts at rank 150 and is tutorial-led down to rank 100 before free management. Caring for your employees before board meetings is the most reliable way to win them, and you can save before a period or meeting and reload a bad result.

steps.text: Work through every Business Management rank until Ichiban Confections holds the top spot in Yokohama.

achievements.summary: Buy up more than 10 companies in Business Management.

guide.context: Only five businesses can be owned at once and Ichiban Confections cannot be sold, so the tenth purchase comes near the end of the climb to rank 1.

steps.text: Purchase businesses in Business Management until 10 cumulative companies have been bought.

achievements.summary: Play at least 10 of the game's minigames.

guide.context: Simply starting a minigame and playing briefly, or losing immediately, is enough to make it count, and the 10 do not have to be ones required by other achievements.

steps.text: Open and try 10 different minigames, including SEGA arcade cabinets and the gambling venues.

achievements.description: Obtained over 10 certificates from the vocational school.
achievements.summary: Obtain more than 10 certificates from the Ounabara Vocational School.

guide.context: Each exam is five questions and passing takes at least three correct answers, with 21 exams available. Questions are drawn randomly from a larger pool and answers are shuffled, so the practical method is to save before paying, take the exam, note any answers you missed when the results appear, then reload and retry.

steps.text: Pass at least 11 exams at the Ounabara Vocational School to earn 11 certificates.

achievements.description: Beat all Dragon Kart cups and rival races.
achievements.summary: Win all four Dragon Kart Cups and all six Rival Races.

guide.context: Winning one cup unlocks the next, and the last two Rival Races plus the Dragon Cup only appear in Chapter 15. A fully upgraded kart gives enough margin to win each cup even with a mistake in one race.

steps.text: Win the Cerberus, Pegasus, Phoenix, and Dragon Cups.
Win all six Rival Races unlocked alongside the cups.

achievements.summary: Beat all three Can Quest courses.

guide.context: Only finishing each course matters; your rank and score on a run do not affect the achievement.

steps.text: Finish the Beginner, Normal, and Hard Can Quest courses with at least the minimum required cans.

achievements.description: Watched all the movies at the theater without falling asleep.
achievements.summary: Watch all 10 movies at the Seagull Cinema without falling asleep.

guide.context: The cinema opens through Substory 08. Each film runs a sheep whack-a-mole minigame where you press the shown button to stay awake; Rapid sheep need five presses, and striking a friendly rooster makes it hurt you instead. Finish one movie to unlock the next.

steps.text: Watch all 10 Seagull Cinema films and stay awake through each one.
steps.note: Any rank works; the only failure is falling asleep.

achievements.description: Entered into intimate relationships with over two female characters.
achievements.summary: Enter intimate relationships with two of the six romanceable women.

guide.context: Finishing any two of these romance substories earns the achievement. Each woman requires one Personality stat at level 10 plus an extra condition, and each then needs three conversations delivering her flowers in batches of 1, then 5, then 10. Flowers 2 Go sells the bouquets in bulk, so buy all 16 of a type at once.

collectibles.name: Sumire
collectibles.method: Raise Passion to level 10 and fully fund Romance Workshop, then deliver 16 Bonsai Trees across three conversations.

collectibles.name: Saeko
collectibles.method: Raise Style to level 10 and max Saeko's bond, then deliver her requested bouquets across three conversations (1, then 5, then 10).

collectibles.name: Eri
collectibles.method: Raise Kindness to level 10 and max Eri's bond, then deliver her requested bouquets across three conversations (1, then 5, then 10).

collectibles.name: Moyakoshi
collectibles.method: Raise Intellect to level 10 and pass all 21 school exams, then deliver 16 Bouquet of Lilies across three conversations.

collectibles.name: Iroha
collectibles.method: Raise Charisma to level 10 and view at least 16 Party Chats, then deliver 16 Bouquet of Roses across three conversations.

collectibles.name: Ririka
collectibles.method: Raise Confidence to level 10 and change Kasuga through all eight non-default jobs, then deliver 16 Bouquet of Pansies across three conversations.

achievements.description: Found all the people who will give you a honk-honk.
achievements.summary: Find all five Honk-Honk NPCs.

guide.context: Each NPC appears at one fixed spot but spawns randomly per map load, so ride a taxi between locations to reload the map and re-roll whether the NPC is there. The Kamurocho and Sotenbori NPCs cannot be reached until Chapter 15.

collectibles.name: Honk-Honk Girl
collectibles.location: Isezaki Ijincho: alley just south of Survive bar

collectibles.name: Honk-Honk Lady
collectibles.location: Isezaki Ijincho: stairwell below ground just north of Wette Kitchen
collectibles.method: Pay 50,000 Yen for +10 Passion, Charisma, and Kindness.

collectibles.name: Honk-Honk Man
collectibles.location: Isezaki Ijincho: behind Sunlight Palace, opened by the Chapter 11 keycard
collectibles.method: Pay 100,000 Yen for +10 to every personality stat.

collectibles.name: Honk-Honk Woman
collectibles.location: Sotenbori: large alleyway by the Shofukocho taxi stop
collectibles.method: Pay 50,000 Yen for +10 Confidence, Passion, and Charisma.

collectibles.name: Honk-Honk Princess
collectibles.location: Kamurocho: alley below the Hotel District map label, nearest the W Shichifuku St. taxi stop
collectibles.method: Pay 30,000 Yen for +10 Intellect, Style, and Charisma.

achievements.description: Someone got run over by a car in battle.
achievements.summary: Get an enemy run over by a car during battle.

guide.context: Enemies roam the streets around Ijincho and can be fought beside active roads, which makes this easy to trigger by accident. Busy roads include Carriage Highway, Yokohama Blvd., and W Tsurukame Highway.

steps.text: Start a battle beside one of the busy roads and knock an enemy into the street so a passing car hits them.

achievements.description: A creep crawled out of a safe for the first time.
achievements.summary: Trigger an enemy to jump out of a safe.

guide.context: Some safes in the sewers and dungeons release an enemy instead of a reward. The first safe in Chapter 6's Ijincho Sewers section is a guaranteed trigger.

steps.text: Open safes until an enemy climbs out; the Chapter 6 Ijincho Sewers safe is guaranteed to do this.

achievements.description: Beat the True Final Millennium Tower.
achievements.summary: Beat the True Final Millennium Tower in Premium Adventure.

guide.context: This second post-story dungeon unlocks after you clear the Final Millennium Tower, and every enemy is level 99. Plan on several maxed jobs per character for the permanent stat bonuses and on upgraded weapons; Invested Vagabond enemies in the Kamurocho Underground Sewers award over 400,000 job experience each. There are no retries before the final boss and no way out until a floor is cleared, so save outside before entering.

steps.text: Clear the True Final Millennium Tower floors, defeating the Thought Entity enemies on the way up.
Defeat Amon on the top floor after he summons copies of the Thought Entity enemies.
